**Tech News Digest — AI Agents Today**

Open-source agent frameworks have hit a major production milestone, with adoption tripling as enterprises embrace autonomous AI. Model-driven agents are quietly replacing hand-coded orchestration in startups, while tool-calling reliability emerges as the new benchmark for frontier models. Meanwhile, multi-agent swarms are moving from demos into regulated enterprise workflows, and observability standards are finally taking shape to trace agent decisions end to end. The era of autonomous, production-grade AI agents is unmistakably underway.
